transferNote: Page-target CDP transfers may omit dedicated-worker target requests; build inventory additionally counts every worker/lazy JavaScript and CSS file as a conservative upper bound.
scope: Built Netlify-policy local CSP preview. Reference pages use CDP 4x page CPU slowdown and cold Fast 4G (9/1.5 Mbps,60ms); mobile uses DPR2. FPS counts actual pitch background paints during playback, after the founded club chose its striped home shirt for that fixture in preparation, so both pitches paint a recorded patterned shirt (observedKits names the worn shirts from the match legend). Pointer-to-second-frame measures presentation latency for post-founding navigation/replay controls. Entry JavaScript/CSS is budgeted; the conservative all-asset compressed inventory, including the lazy engine worker, is reported separately; page-target transfers may omit worker targets. No universal device-speed or live-provider validation claim.
